ci.note: connected E2E strict-mode: availability loading paragraph added a second role=status inside creator-editor

behaviour: Creators block date ranges per guide in the editor (Unavailable dates panel); ranges are validated (today..+365d, max 61 days, max 40 per guide) and overlapping ranges are refused with 409.
The public guide page lists upcoming blocked ranges and the request panel refuses an overlapping request before sending; the database refuses it too (dates_unavailable → 400).
Blocking dates never publishes, books, charges or changes visibility; it only narrows acceptable requests.

steps.step: creator editor shows the availability panel
creator blocks a range in production
traveller guide page lists the unavailable dates
overlapping request is refused in production
creator removes the range; production left clean

production.cleanup: all verification ranges removed; public read returned [] at the end

honestLimits: This is an advisory blacklist, not a calendar: there is no capacity, no per-day slots and no instant booking.
A traveller can still request a range that only partially overlaps; it is refused, they must pick another range.
Ranges are per guide; there is no creator-level holiday calendar across guides.
No notifications are sent when a creator blocks or removes dates.
